mapper.select: SELECT base_stats.enabledDevices, base_stats.onlineDevices, base_stats.offlineDevices, base_stats.alarmingDevices, COALESCE(alert_counts.unhandledAlerts, 0) as unhandledAlerts, COALESCE(alert_counts.todayAlerts, 0) as todayAlerts, base_stats.last5MinReportDevices FROM ( SELECT COUNT(d.id) as enabledDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN d.online_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as onlineDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN d.online_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as offlineDevices, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ua.device_id IS NOT NULL THEN ua.device_id ELSE NULL END) as alarmingDevices, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.last_seen_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) THEN d.id ELSE NULL END) as last5MinReportDevices FROM devices d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT device_id FROM alerts WHERE status IN ('UNHANDLED', 'HANDLING') ) ua ON ua.device_id = d.id WHERE d.enabled = 1 ) base_stats CROSS JOIN ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE status IN ('UNHANDLED', 'HANDLING')) as unhandledAlerts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE DATE(created_time) = CURDATE()) as todayAlerts ) alert_counts

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(data_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as time, AVG(temperature) as temperature, AVG(humidity) as humidity FROM sensor_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND data_time BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(data_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') ORDER BY data_time ASC
